## Repository Structure

All paths are relative to the repository root `plant_immunity_Vitis/`.
GitHub repository: <https://github.com/vierocka/plant_immunity_Vitis>

```
plant_immunity_Vitis/
│
├── 01_QC_and_Filtering/
│   └── Batch_effects/
│       ├── read_checks.R            # Batch effect detection in mapping metrics (GLM + Spearman)
│       ├── batch_effects.R          # PCA comparison of 8 normalization strategies
│       └── PCA_all_methods_4x4.pdf  # Supplementary Figure 2 — PCA grid
│
├── 02_Normalization_and_DGEA/
│   ├── DGEA.R                       # Differential expression analysis (t-test on rlog+ComBat)
│   └── Heteroscedasticity_check.R   # Mean–variance homoscedasticity test
│
├── 03_AED/
│   └── DGE_bySFandCB_divergence.R  # Aggregated Expression Divergence + permutation test
│
├── 05_transcriptional_dynamics/
│   ├── DEGs_counts_global_tests.R   # GLM modelling of DEG counts (genotype × time × direction)
│   └── proportions_exploratory_analysis.R
│
├── 06_PCNWA/
│
├── 07_exploratory_Splicing_junctions/   # Exploratory splicing junction analysis (not part of main paper)
│   ├── GCNA_network_analysis.R      # Full co-transcriptional network pipeline
│   ├── create_immunity_classes.R    # PTI/ETI/shared gene classification
│   ├── Figure_5.R                   # Figure 5: SOBIR1 hub + EDS1-SAG101 network
│   └── Figure3_pheatmap_MMs.R      # Figure 3: immunity layer heatmap
│
├── Athaliana_homology/              # Arabidopsis → Vitis homology mapping files
│
├── data_files/
│   ├── RawCounts.csv                        # Raw gene counts (26,169 genes × 36 samples)
│   ├── Rlogs.csv                            # rlog + ComBat values (R/DESeq2; used for PCA, DGEA, network)
│   ├── SizeFactorNorm_ComBat_36samples.csv  # SF + log₂ + ComBat (used for AED)
│   ├── Patterns_01_DUE.csv                  # Temporal expression pattern per DE gene (3,553 genes)
│   ├── Vitis_gene_immunity_class.csv        # PTI / ETI / shared gene classification
│   └── node1_node2_ConfidenceScore_stringDB.csv  # STRING-db edge list for hub genes
│
├── jupyter_nb/
│   ├── plant_immunity_python_toolkit.ipynb  # Python learning notebook (PyDESeq2 + VST teaching version)
│   └── build_python_toolkit_notebook.py     # Builder script that generates the notebook
│   # Note: the notebook uses PyDESeq2 VST as a Python-accessible approximation for teaching.
│   # The published analysis uses R/DESeq2 rlog (Rlogs.csv); both approaches are conceptually equivalent.
│
├── publication/
│   ├── Vitis.qmd                    # Main Quarto document (assembles all sections)
│   ├── _quarto.yml                  # Quarto project configuration
│   ├── references.bib               # Full bibliography
│   ├── 00-summary.qmd               # Project summary and abstract
│   ├── 01-collaborators.qmd         # Contributors, funding, citation, license
│   ├── 02-problems_limitations.qmd  # Problem definition and study limitations
│   ├── 03-methods.qmd               # Methods overview (scripts + parameters)
│   ├── 04-results.qmd               # Key quantitative results
│   └── 05-repository-structure.qmd  # This file
│
├── shiny_local/                     # Local Shiny app source (DuckDB-backed)
│
├── bioxriv_ms_version.pdf           # bioRxiv preprint (Hádlík et al., 2025; doi:10.1101/2025.11.27.690962)
├── README.md                        # Repository overview
└── LICENSE                          # CC BY-NC 4.0
```

## Interactive Companion App

For interactive browsing of the same dataset, visit:
🔗 <https://vierakovacova.shinyapps.io/playing_with_immunity/>

The app enables:

- Gene-level queries with dynamic log₂ fold-change plots
- Real-time GO and Reactome enrichment browsing
- Interactive co-expression network visualization
- Filtered export for reproducible downstream analyses
